Instructions for Use
Device description: The Helix Pacemaker System is a cardiac pacing system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Helix Pacemaker System is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5-Tesla and 3-Tesla
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 30 T/m
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 200 T/m/s per axis
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Transmit Coil Type There are no Transmit Coil restrictions
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg
Head SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg
Maximum active scan time 30 minutes
Wait time between sessions 10 minutes
Device Configuration Therapy OFF
MR image artifact: the artifact may extend up to 40 mm beyond the implant.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
